page.overview:
What is Sektor's Rocket?

More heat seeking rockets like this highly explosive weapon are launched from Sektor's chest cavity.

In MKX, when Tri-Borg uses the Sektor (LK-9T9) variation, the rockets become a part of his arsenal and his moveset. With the rockets shooting out of his arms, chest cavity and back.
